title: 'Himekishi-sama no Himo' Reveals Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tooru Shirogane 's Himekishi-sama no Himo ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ) light novel revealed additional staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Monday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Teaser Trailer and Visual Revealed, Gets January 2027 Release
content: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime has revealed its first teaser trailer and visual, along with a January 2027 release date. The anime was announced in February 2025. As previously announced, Junichi Suwabe will voice Matthew, while Mikako Komatsu stars as Arwin, the Crimson Princess Knight.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight TV Anime's Teaser Video Reveals More Staff Members, January 2027 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed on Monday the teaser promotional video, teaser visual, additional staff members, and January 2027 debut for the television anime adaptation of Toru Shirogane 's The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ( Himekishi-sama no Himo ) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actor Kenichi Suzumura Returns From Hiatus
content: Suzumura went on hiatus in February earlier this year. Intention explained at the time that Suzumura had been in poor health, and doctors diagnosed the issue as adjustment disorder.
author: ANN

title: Hero Killer Animated TV Series Reveals Director, Passion Paris Joins Production
content: The upcoming animated television series adaptation of the Hero Killer webtoon revealed new production details at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival on Friday, including the adaptation's director, an additional production partner, and its first teaser visual (pictured above).
author: ANN

title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 New Information to Be Revealed on July 4
content: Delicious in Dungeon ( Dungeon Meshi ) will share new information about its highly anticipated Season 2 during Anime Expo 2026 in Los Angeles next month. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale in June 2024.
author: Anime Corner

title: Tekken 8 Game Reveals Bob's August 19 Early Access Release in Gameplay Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed at the EVO 2026 event on Sunday the gameplay reveal trailer for Bob, one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3 . The character will be available for early access on August 19, and will release officially on August 24.
author: ANN

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Game's New Trailer Introduces Samurai Outriders
content: Sony Interactive Entertainment revealed at the EVO 2026 event on Sunday a new trailer for PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game . The trailer highlights the Samurai Outriders team, featuring Ghost Rider, Blade, Loki, and Deadpool.
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds Kanna Hourai's 'Give 'Em Hell, Miran Yata!!'
content: K MANGA describes its story: Miran Yata, a first year at Flower High School, is already barreling down the path to being a total loner not even two months into the school year! But she's completely unbothered by this.
author: ANN
